description: Generate a self-contained .html diagram file from Mermaid source (params ≤1MiB): the file embeds mermaid.js and renders itself when opened — double-click to view, printable to PDF. Send Mermaid source (e.g. "graph TD; A-->B"), not Markdown. The server does not validate Mermaid syntax: bad syntax is not rejected here — the opened file shows mermaid's own error panel instead (fail visible, never silent); only empty content is rejected. securityLevel is strict (click/href interactions disabled); output ≤8MiB. Returns {content_base64, bytes, filename}

filename.description: Output file name, optional (default diagram.html; .html enforced)

name: make_diagram
